name: agents-github
description: GitHub operations agents: pull-request lifecycle, issue triage, release automation, multi-repository coordination, project boards, workflow engineering and repository scaffolding. Deliberately not forgeplan-aware — these operate on GitHub, not on the artifact graph. Use when the work is GitHub itself: opening a PR with a real checklist, finding what is blocked on CI, cutting a release, or propagating one change across many repositories. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
